title: Building Ember Lives with Claude Code, Codex and PixelLab: free beta, looking for gameplay feedback
author: laughing_gorilla123
selftext:
I've been building Ember Lives, a browser-based idle MMORPG, using Claude Code for development, Codex for code review, and PixelLab for the art.



The game combines exploration and equipment upgrades with crafting, trading, family, and continuing into another life. The free beta is available here: [https://ember-lives.vercel.app](https://ember-lives.vercel.app)



Recently, I've been working on land permits, fixed locations for homes and workshops, travel through the map, and the mobile interface. One thing this process keeps reminding me is that passing code tests and making a game enjoyable are different problems. AI tools have helped with implementation and review, but I still need people to tell me where the game feels confusing, inconvenient, or unbalanced.



I'd especially appreciate feedback on the early guidance, the economy, and anything awkward on mobile. Bugs and ideas are welcome too. Even a short note about where you got stuck would help.



The game supports Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Hindi. The five screenshots show the Korean interface.



Thanks for taking a look and helping me improve it.
